protocol.name: mudhuts_shell
protocol.copyright: This protocol is part of mudhuts, a from-scratch Wayland compositor. It is not shared with or endorsed by any other project.

interface.name: mudhuts_shell_v1

description.summary: assign a window's role within mudhuts' Hut model

interface.description: Lets a client declare how one of its own xdg_toplevels should be organized within mudhuts: as an ordinary Main Window (the default, needing no request at all), a Sub-Window docked to a screen edge until dragged out, or an always-on-top Alert. See mudhuts_window_role_v1.

request.name: get_window_role

description.summary: create a role object for one of this client's own toplevels

request.description: toplevel must belong to the client making this request. Creating a second role object for the same toplevel is a protocol error.

request.name: get_authority

description.summary: get the privileged, token-gated authority object

request.description: For a standalone helper program mudhuts itself spawns (with a one-time secret token in its own environment) to tag *other* clients' toplevels — apps that don't speak mudhuts_shell_v1 natively. Any client may request this object, but every request on it besides authenticate is refused until authenticate succeeds — see mudhuts_shell_authority_v1.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Does not affect any mudhuts_window_role_v1/mudhuts_shell_authority_v1 objects already created.

interface.name: mudhuts_window_role_v1

description.summary: the role of one Main-Window-owning toplevel

interface.description: Every toplevel starts out as a plain Main Window (equivalent to set_main) until one of these requests changes that.

request.name: set_main

description.summary: declare this toplevel an ordinary Main Window

request.description: The default; only useful to explicitly move a toplevel back out of the Sub-Window/Alert role it was previously given.

request.name: set_sub

description.summary: declare this toplevel a Sub-Window of main

request.description: main must be an existing Main Window in the same Hut as this toplevel. Starts docked to whichever screen edge it's nearest, minimized to a small handle until the user drags it out.

request.name: set_alert

description.summary: declare this toplevel an Alert of main

request.description: main must be an existing Main Window in the same Hut as this toplevel. Alerts always float on top of main's content and can't be docked/minimized.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Does not change the toplevel's current role — it stays whatever it was last set to.

interface.name: mudhuts_shell_authority_v1

description.summary: privileged window tagging for a trusted helper program

interface.description: Lets a helper program mudhuts itself spawned tag *other* clients' toplevels by role, for apps that don't speak mudhuts_shell_v1 natively (matched by whatever rule the helper itself implements — app_id, title, ...). Toplevels are identified by the identifier string each gets from the standard ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1 protocol, not by a direct object reference — this object and that one are expected to be used together by the same client. Every request but authenticate is refused (a protocol error) until authenticate succeeds, since binding this interface at all doesn't by itself prove the client is the trusted helper.

entry.name: not_authenticated
entry.summary: a request other than authenticate was made before authenticating

entry.name: bad_token
entry.summary: the token presented to authenticate didn't match

entry.name: unknown_toplevel
entry.summary: no current Main Window has this identifier

request.name: authenticate
request.description: token must match the MUDHUTS_AUTHORITY_TOKEN this helper was spawned with, or this object is destroyed with a bad_token protocol error. Every other request on this object is a not_authenticated protocol error until this succeeds; calling it again after already succeeding is a no-op.

request.name: set_sub

description.summary: tag another client's toplevel a Sub-Window of main

request.description: identifier and main_identifier are ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 identifier strings, each naming a current Main Window — an unknown_toplevel protocol error if either doesn't. Starts docked, same as mudhuts_window_role_v1.set_sub.

description.summary: tag another client's toplevel an Alert of main

request.name: set_main

description.summary: tag another client's toplevel an ordinary Main Window

request.description: Only useful to move a toplevel back out of a Sub-Window/Alert role this same authority previously gave it. unknown_toplevel if identifier doesn't name a current Main Window.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Does not change any toplevel's current role.
